note: The Settings section; its screen is "About annai" → annai について / 关于 annai. ja 情報 is iOS's own word for About (一般 → 情報); zh 关于 as in iOS's 关于本机.
The catalog screen, and the button that opens it. The phones' own word for Add in both languages (ホーム画面に追加 / 添加到主屏幕).
The Settings section; Backups (its screen, the automatic ones) is the same word: ja has no plural, and zh 备份 covers both. Automatic backups → 自動バックアップ / 自动备份.
A booking confirmation's screen; Bookings on the Plan is the same word. ja 予約 is what hotels and airlines say; zh 预订 (hotels, flights) over 预约 (appointments).
What you and Shiori said. ja 会話 over トーク (LINE's word, chatty); zh 对话 over 聊天 (casual, "chat") and 会话 (technical, "session").
As Android's 開発者向けオプション / 开发者选项. Its button, "Simulate a trip", has its own row.
Standard in both (iOS 解析 is Analytics, a different thing). "Copy diagnostics" → 診断情報をコピー / 复制诊断信息.
The driving screen and the Now screen's button to it. ja 運転中 and zh 驾驶中 say "while driving", as iOS's 運転集中モード / 驾驶专注模式 frame it; 運転 / 驾驶 alone read as a verb.

Removes everything annai keeps here. ja 消去 as iOS's own (Apple's guide: 「iPhoneを消去する」). zh: iOS says 抹掉 (Apple's guide: 抹掉 iPhone), Android 清除 (清除数据); 清除 is the plainer word and reads as final. For you: 清除 or iPhone's 抹掉.

Chrome's own words for its flags page (試験運用版の機能 / 实验性功能), so a phone user may have seen them. ja 試験的な機能 or 実験的機能 are plainer alternatives; zh 实验功能 is shorter. Decision 5's switch, "Unfinished translations", will live here. For you: ja 試験運用版, or 試験的な機能.
A trip's files. The phones' own words (iOS's Files app is ファイル / 文件).
A file's earlier versions. ja 履歴 as in 閲覧履歴; zh 历史 (历史版本). Kept apart from the Trace (記録 / 记录).
Settings → Shiori → Languages. "Languages you speak" → 話す言語 / 你说的语言. The coming row "annai's screens in" is not on screen yet, so it is not here.
MCP stays as written (a protocol's name). ja サーバー with the long mark, as Microsoft and Apple write it; zh 服务器 with a space after the Latin.
ja モデル is the only word Japanese uses for an AI model; 模型 / 型 would be wrong. zh 模型 is the standard (大模型).
The phone's own word in both languages (Settings → 通知).

The top bar's first tab: where you are and what is next. ja いま (hiragana) is short and soft on a tab; 現在 reads like a timestamp and 今 alone is easy to miss. zh 此刻 is a noun ("this moment") and sits well as a tab; 现在 is plainer but reads as an adverb on its own, 当前 is technical. For you: いま / 此刻, or 現在 / 现在.
The phone's own words (iOS's Photos app is 写真 / 照片). "Photos for Shiori" → Shiori に送る写真 / 发给 Shiori 的照片.

Day tabs and a timetable. ja 予定 is what a schedule is called ("今日の予定"); プラン is common in travel ads, 計画 sounds like a project, 旅程 is formal. zh 行程 is exactly a trip's day-by-day plan (行程安排); 计划 is generic. "Plan the trip with Shiori" then reads 予定を立てる / 安排行程.

Standard in both (ブラウザのプラグイン, 浏览器插件). 拡張機能 / 扩展程序 are browsers' words for extensions, a different thing. A plugin is the same word; its own name is shown as written (decision 10), and annai translates only its official plugins' descriptive names.
The trip told afterwards. ja 振り返り over まとめ (a summary of anything) and リキャップ (rare); zh 回顾 over 总结 (a report).
The route played back on a map. ja リプレイ is what games and sports call it; 再生 means play (a video). zh 回放 over 重播 (a rerun).

The same words as the phone's own Settings app (iOS and Android, ja-JP and zh-CN). "Settings → Models" becomes 設定 → モデル / 设置 → 模型. Where a sentence could mean either, say "annai の設定" / "annai 的设置" against the phone's "設定アプリ" / "“设置” App".

ja: 旅のシミュレーション
note: Developer's screen; decision 11 translates its own words. Built on trip (旅 / 旅行).
The phone's word: Apple's guide has 「iPhoneでストレージを管理する」 / 管理 iPhone 储存空间, Android ストレージ / 存储. zh 存储空间 is what both platforms' users read; 储存空间 is Apple's spelling, 存储 alone is Android's.
Standard in both. A tool (one of hers) is the same word.

Everything annai recorded (decision 11: the Trace's own words are translated). 記録 / 记录 say what it is in a plain word. トレース / 追踪 keep the developer's sense but mean little to a traveller; ログ / 日志 are developers' words too. File history is 履歴 / 历史 (see History), so the two don't meet. Experimental's "Remote trace" follows it: リモート記録 / 远程记录. For you: 記録 / 记录, or トレース / 追踪.

The design's own example (§7) is 旅. ja 旅 is short for a tab and warm; 旅行 is the everyday noun, a little more matter-of-fact. Trips → 旅, a trip → 旅 (see trip). zh 旅行 is the natural noun ("我的旅行"); 旅程 is literary and 行程 is taken by Plan. For you: ja 旅, or 旅行.
As Apple's guide says 「iOSをアップデートする」 / 更新 iOS. ja 更新 is also understood, but アップデート is what phones say for a new version.

Settings → Voice: how she speaks and hears you. ja 音声 (as in 音声入力, 音声設定) keeps 声 for a voice she speaks with (see voice) and for the welcome's Koe (声). zh 语音 is the settings word (语音设置); 声音 is "sound" or a voice (see voice).
The welcome; "Welcome to annai" → annai へようこそ / 欢迎使用 annai, and "Show the welcome again" → ようこそ画面をもう一度表示 / 再次显示欢迎页. It is where 声 and 心 are explained (see Koe, Kokoro).
Archive trip, Archived trips, Unarchive (アーカイブを解除 / 取消归档). Standard in both (Gmail's words).
Where automatic backups go (GitHub, S3…). ja バックアップ先 (先 as in 保存先); zh 备份位置 (备份目标 is technical).
annai's cards at the top of a screen, and Shiori's cards. Standard in both.
annai's catalog of plugins (the Add screen). ja カタログ. zh 目录 is literal but also means a table of contents; 插件库 or 扩展库 say "a library of add-ons". For you: zh 目录 or 插件库.
The chip on a booking annai read but you haven't confirmed; Confirmed → 確認済み / 已确认. ja 要確認 is the usual stamp-like word; zh 请核对 (核对 is checking against the original).
The voice chip, "the GPS chip" on the dock: to a reader, a button. ja チップ and zh 标签 / 条状标签 are designers' words. The voice chip → 音声ボタン / 语音按钮, the GPS chip → GPSボタン / GPS 按钮.

annai's bar at the bottom (camera · Shiori · type). ja: iOS writes Dock for its own (a different thing); ドック reads the same. zh: iOS's 程序坞 is its app dock, so 底栏 (bottom bar) avoids the mix-up. For you: zh 底栏 or 程序坞.
Export everything, Export trip, Last export. ja エクスポート over Apple's 書き出し, which many readers find stiff; zh 导出 is standard. For you: エクスポート or 書き出し.
Photographers' words in both: ゴールデンアワー (マジックアワー is the looser cousin), 黄金时刻 (黄金时段 is TV prime time).

Koe and Kokoro, "her two halves" (Her two halves, Show what the halves tell each other). ja 半身 (ふたつの半身) keeps the image of one being in two parts; 片割れ is "the other one of a pair". zh 分身 is natural for one character in two, but suggests copies; 两半 is literal and awkward in a sentence ("显示两半之间的话"). The screens can often name them instead ("Koe と Kokoro"). For you: 半身 / 分身, or the names (Koe と Kokoro / Koe 和 Kokoro).

When she summarizes on her own (Settings → Models). Built on Tidy up (整理 / 整理), the menu that does the same now, so the two read as one idea. メンテナンス / 维护 sound like the app being fixed. For you: 会話の整理 / 对话整理, built on Tidy up's 整理, or メンテナンス / 维护.
A provider's API key (Get a key, Jina key, "Include API keys"). ja キー / APIキー, not 鍵 (a lock's key). zh 密钥 / API 密钥, not 钥匙.
The role that talks with you. ja メイン, zh 主要 ("主要: 与你对话"); 主模型 is clearer alone but the label already says it is a list of models.
Places and guides downloaded for no signal. As Google Maps' オフラインマップ / 离线地图 sound; zh 离线包 is what apps call a downloadable bundle.

en: Open a trip someone sent you
ja: 送られてきた旅を開く
note: A button that install.js also quotes by name, so both must read the same. Built on trip.
What encrypts a backup. ja パスフレーズ is the standard word; パスワード would hide that it may be a sentence. zh 密码短语 (Apple and Microsoft use it); 口令 is older.

How she talks (a file the user can edit). ja 性格 over パーソナリティ (radio hosts) and 人格 (too heavy). zh 性格 is plain; 人设 is what mainland users call an AI character's persona, natural but colloquial. For you: zh 性格 or 人设.
Who serves a model (Providers, Add a provider). ja プロバイダー with the long mark (Microsoft's spelling; プロバイダ without it is older). zh 提供商 as AI services say (模型提供商); 服务商 is a little broader.
The server that sends reminders while annai is closed; its section is "Relay" (中継 / 中继). ja 中継サーバー is clearer alone; zh 推送中继服务器 likewise.
Yes-or-no checks. ja クイック判定 (即決 is a person's quick decision); zh 快速判断.
Hours she holds her own wakes (Quiet from, Quiet until). Not the phone's おやすみモード / 勿扰模式 (Do Not Disturb), which is a different thing; plain words keep them apart.
A time or place reminder ("Reminder (3)" on a stack of cards). ja リマインダー as iOS's app; お知らせ is a notice, 通知 is Notifications. zh 提醒 (提醒事项 is iOS's app name, too long here).
The lists each job tries in order (Main, Utility…). ja 役割, zh 角色 (also "character", but in settings it reads as a role).
The small mark on her spoken lines. Built on Speech out (読み上げ / 朗读). The setting "Show what she says" → 話した言葉を表示 / 显示她说的话, and "Show what she said" → 話した言葉を見る / 查看她说的话.
A skill plugin (SKILL.md). ja スキル as AI assistants say it; zh 技能 (技能包).

How Shiori hears you (transcription models). ja 聞き取り, not 音声入力, which is iOS's word for keyboard dictation (Apple's guide: 「テキストを音声入力する」), a different thing on the same screen. zh 语音识别 (speech recognition), not 语音输入 (keyboard voice input) or 听写 (iOS's dictation). For you: 聞き取り / 语音识别, or 音声入力 / 语音输入 (the phones' words for dictation).

Shiori's voice (voices). ja 読み上げ and zh 朗读 are the phones' words for text read aloud (Apple's ja guide: 「画面上のテキストや入力したテキストを読み上げる」; zh 朗读 from memory); 音声出力 / 语音输出 sound like an audio jack. For you: 読み上げ / 朗读, or 音声出力 / 语音输出.
What her model calls may cost in a day. ja 1日の利用額 (利用額 is what a card statement says); 予算 would suggest a budget she plans. zh 每日花费 (花费 is everyday; 费用 is formal).

Station-stamp marks for visited places. ja スタンプ is exactly the 駅スタンプ a traveller collects. zh 纪念章 is what scenic spots' ink stamps are called (集纪念章, 盖章); 印章 is a seal, 邮票 a postage stamp. For you: zh 纪念章, or 打卡章.
She puts the earlier lines out of mind; every line stays. The divider "Started fresh" → 新しく始めました / 已重新开始. ja リセット or zh 重置 would wrongly suggest something is deleted.
ja 要約 (summary) with 今すぐ as iOS's 今すぐアップデート; zh 立即总结 (立即 as 立即更新). 概要 / 摘要 are nouns for a document's abstract.
The Conversation's menu (Summarize now, Start fresh). ja 整理 is short for a button; 片付け is tidying a room. zh 整理 likewise.
On Tools and the Trace. ja オン/オフ is how iOS writes a switch; スイッチ alone is a hardware switch. zh 开关 is the settings word.
An ability and its models (Voices and transcription). ja 文字起こし is the everyday word; zh 语音转文字 is plain where 转写 / 转录 are technical.
Follows Trips: "Start a trip" → 旅を始める / 开始旅行, "Trip name" → 旅の名前 / 旅行名称, "Archived trips" → アーカイブした旅 / 已归档的旅行. If ja chooses 旅行 for Trips, this follows.
Summaries and small jobs. ja 補助 and zh 辅助 (helper) say what it is better than ユーティリティ / 实用.

A voice she speaks with (Add a voice, Browser voice, Shiori's voice). The phones' own word for a speech voice: iOS's 読み上げコンテンツ → 声 / 朗读内容 → 声音 (from memory, not confirmed). The screen is 音声 / 语音 (see Voice). ja 声 is also what the welcome says Koe means; that suits her.
One time she acts (Wakes per hour, Steps per wake, "Shiori woke: …"). ja 起動 is what a program does; 目覚め is a person waking, warmer but odd in a count (1時間あたりの目覚め). zh 唤醒 fits both.

Koe's list of chat models (チャットモデル / 对话模型) with Speech in and Speech out. クラシック / 经典 keep it a name, paired with Realtime. 標準 / 标准 are plainer but sound like the recommended default, which it isn't. For you: クラシック / 经典, or 標準 / 标准.

Koe's list that hears and speaks in one stream; the chip says "Voice on · Realtime". Koe stays Latin (decision 6). Keep " · " (a middle dot with spaces) in every language, so the name is the same everywhere and the check can find it; Japanese would usually write ・ without spaces. For you: "Koe · リアルタイム" with the English dot and spaces, or "Koe・リアルタイム" as Japanese writes it.

ja: ライブで聞いています
note: The chip while a live session's microphone is open; it must be unmistakable that audio is going out (spec K5). Built on Live voice. A live session → ライブセッション / 实时会话.

What a realtime model does: your voice goes to the provider as you speak (also the Add screen's ability chip). ja ライブ音声 (ライブ as in a live broadcast) keeps it apart from リアルタイム, Koe's list. zh has one natural word, 实时, for both; that is honest, since Koe · Realtime is the list that uses live voice.
The voice chip's words ("Voice auto · off", "Voice on · car audio"); its menu's Auto, On and Off are 自動, オン, オフ / 自动, 开, 关. Built on Voice (音声 / 语音). "Voice auto · off" → 音声自動 · オフ / 语音自动 · 关.
As Voice on.
Voice on · car audio → 音声オン · カーオーディオ / 语音开启 · 车载音频. ja オン/オフ as iOS writes switches. zh 开启 / 关闭 read whole on a chip, where 开 / 关 alone look clipped; the menu's buttons can stay 开 / 关.

iPhone, Safari's share list. Confirmed on Apple's iPhone User Guide, "Bookmark a website" (ja-jp, iph42ab2f3a7) and "Open as web app" (zh-cn, iphea86e5236), fetched 2026-10-23: 「ホーム画面に追加」, “添加到主屏幕”. The same pages say current Safari reaches Share through the page menu (ページメニュー / 页面菜单) when the tab bar is compact, and that the list may need scrolling or "Edit Actions" (アクションを編集 / 编辑操作) to show it.
iPhone and Android. Confirmed for Android (Google's "Change app permissions", ja and zh-Hans: 許可 / 允许, 許可しない / 不允许) and Apple's notification page (通知を許可 / 允许通知).

Android, from holding an app's icon. Confirmed only by secondary sources (Japanese and Chinese Android how-to sites describing Pixel's long-press menu); Google's own pages name the path through Settings → Apps instead. Vendors' Android (Xiaomi, Huawei, OPPO) may word it differently.

Current iOS: Settings → Apps → Safari. Confirmed on Apple's "Customize Safari settings" (iphb3100d149, fetched 2026-10-23): ja 「アプリ」をタップしてから、「Safari」; zh 轻点 App，然后轻点“Safari 浏览器”. So: 設定 → アプリ → Safari, 设置 → App → Safari 浏览器. Apple's zh writes App in Latin letters.

Safari's Microphone and Location choices on iPhone: Ask / Deny / Allow. Not confirmed on a fetched page: ja 確認 (Apple's guide writes 次回確認 for location's Ask Next Time), zh 询问 (Apple writes 下次询问). Check on a phone.
Android. Chrome's help calls it その他アイコン / “更多”图标 (More); "the browser's menu" covers browsers other than Chrome. Use full-width parentheses in ja and zh.
Confirmed on Apple's iPhone User Guide (ja-jp, zh-cn, iOS 27 pages, fetched 2026-10-23): ホーム画面, 主屏幕. Android's Home screen is the same words in both (Google's Chrome help, ja and zh-Hans).
annai's phrase for annai installed on an iPhone, made from the platform's words. zh keeps Apple's App in Latin letters, as iOS's zh-CN does ("网页 App").

ja: アプリをインストール
note: Android, Chrome's menu. Current Chrome (Google's "Use web apps" help, en, ja and zh-Hans, fetched 2026-10-23) says More → Install and create shortcut → Install: インストールしてショートカットを作成 → インストール, 安装并创建快捷方式 → 安装. So the English "Install app" or "Add to Home screen" is out of date too; the ja and zh pages are marked machine-translated. Older Chrome's "Add to Home screen" is ホーム画面に追加 / 添加到主屏幕, the same words as iPhone's. For you (and the English): Chrome's current words, インストールしてショートカットを作成 → インストール / 安装并创建快捷方式 → 安装, with the English changed to match.

Safari's own Location setting (Settings → Apps → Safari → Location) and Android's Location permission. ja 位置情報 is confirmed for Android (Google's help) and is iOS's usual word. zh: Android says 位置信息 (confirmed, Google's help); iPhone's Safari row is likely 位置 (not confirmed). Follow the platform the sentence is for.
iPhone Settings → Privacy & Security. Confirmed on the same page: 「位置情報サービス」, “定位服务”.

Open in Maps: Apple Maps on iPhone, Google Maps elsewhere. Apple's app is マップ / 地图 (iPhone User Guide contents, fetched 2026-10-23); Google's is Google マップ / Google 地图. "Open in Maps" → マップで開く / 在地图中打开.

iPhone (Settings → Apps → Safari → Microphone) and Android (a permission). Confirmed: Apple's "Control access to hardware features" (zh-cn, iph168c4bbd5): 麦克风; Google's Android help (ja, zh-Hans): マイク, 麦克风. The Safari row itself (マイク / 麦克风 under Safari) is the same word but its page wasn't fetched.

Also over mobile data (backups). ja モバイルデータ通信 is iOS's word (confirmed on Apple's ja-jp guide, fetched 2026-10-23); Android says モバイルデータ. zh: iPhone says 蜂窝数据 (confirmed, Apple's zh-cn guide), Android 移动数据, and people say 流量. 移动数据 is the plain one. For you: zh 移动数据 or iPhone's 蜂窝数据.

What current iOS calls the Safari button annai's English names aA. Confirmed on Apple's ja-jp and zh-cn guides (fetched 2026-10-23): ページメニューボタン, “页面菜单”按钮. annai's English says aA; a draft should say what the English says until the English changes.
Android, App info → Permissions. Confirmed on Google's "Change app permissions" (support.google.com/android/answer/9431959, ja and zh-Hans, fetched 2026-10-23): [権限], 权限.

ja: プライバシーとセキュリティ
note: iPhone Settings. Confirmed on Apple's "Control the location information you share" (iph3dd5f9be, ja-jp and zh-cn, fetched 2026-10-23): 「プライバシーとセキュリティ」, “隐私与安全” (not 隐私与安全性).
Apple's zh-CN name for Safari is "Safari 浏览器" (every zh-cn iPhone guide page fetched 2026-10-23 writes it so; the app's label on the phone is Safari浏览器). ja keeps Safari.

The row for Safari's sites in Location Services. ja "SafariのWebサイト" is from an Apple Community answer (discussionsjapan.apple.com), not an Apple page; Apple's guides now write ウェブサイト, so the phone may show either. zh is not confirmed: secondary sources give "Safari网站", and Apple's own naming suggests "Safari 浏览器网站". Check on a phone.
The phone's Settings app, first word of every path. Confirmed (Apple ja-jp/zh-cn guides; Google's Android help): 「設定」, “设置”. Paths keep " → " between steps.
iPhone. Confirmed on Apple's "Change notification settings" (iph7c3d96bab, ja-jp and zh-cn, fetched 2026-10-23): 「設定」→「通知」→ app; “设置” → “通知” → App.
iPhone's Share button. Confirmed on the same Apple pages: 「共有」, “共享”. Note zh: iPhone says 共享, Android and most Chinese apps say 分享; follow the platform the sentence is for.
The browser's per-site settings (desktop, Android). Confirmed on Google's "Use your camera and microphone in Chrome" (answer/2693767, ja and zh-Hans): [サイトの設定], 网站设置.
Android's word for a long press (Google's help says 長押し, 点按并按住 / 长按). Apple's ja guide writes タッチして押さえたまま; 長押し / 长按 are what people say and fit both.

Apple's Wallet app, as the iOS 27 iPhone User Guide's contents name its section (ja-jp and zh-cn, fetched 2026-10-23): ウォレット, 钱包. Older iOS showed Wallet in Latin letters in Japanese; check the app's label on a phone. "Wallet passes" → ウォレットのパス / 钱包卡券.

Safari's per-site menu (the English says "tap aA"). Not confirmed: Apple's current guides call that button the page menu (ページメニュー / 页面菜单) and no fetched page names the per-site item. The English copy may need updating too (live-help.js still says aA). Check on a phone.

A Location Services choice. Not confirmed on an Apple page: ja older iOS wrote このAppの使用中, and a recent Apple Community answer quotes このアプリの使用中 (Apple's iOS 27 guides now write アプリ, not App); zh 使用 App 期间 is from secondary sources. Check on a phone.
Kept as written. Note zh: iPhone's Settings says 无线局域网 and many Android phones WLAN, but Wi-Fi is what everyone reads and says. For you: zh Wi-Fi or iPhone's 无线局域网.
As written; zh 安卓 is common speech, but Google and the phones write Android.
Always lower case, in Latin letters. The welcome explains it: "annai (案内) is Japanese for guidance" (src/ui/screens/welcome.js, its first step); a ja translation keeps that line's 案内.
As written (Apple's own ja and zh pages write Apple; 苹果 is speech).
A backup place, and where to report a problem. Forgejo, Gitea, S3 and WebDAV in the same sentence are kept as written too.

As written (谷歌 is speech). Google's own names for its products are localized by Google: "Google Search" (the grounded card's "From Google Search", src/ui/screens/talk.js) is Google 検索 / Google 搜索, as Google writes them.
The chip and live mode: GPS on → GPS オン / GPS 开. Kept as written; 位置情報 / 定位 are the Location rows.
iOS 16.4 or later → iOS 16.4 以降 / iOS 16.4 或更高版本.
Apple's name, as written in every language.
